Name: DJI
Description:
DJI is the global leader in developing and manufacturing innovative drone and camera technology for commercial and recreational use. 

DJI was founded and is run by people with a passion for remote-controlled helicopters and experts in flight-control technology and camera stabilization. The company is dedicated to making aerial technology accessible, reliable and easy to use for creators, innovators and businesses around the world. 
 
DJI has expanded its expertise and innovative technology to enterprises, government agencies and different industries around the world. DJI Enterprise was formed in order to help businesses realize the potential of aerial technology in their operations. DJI has expanded its enterprise solutions to include aerial platforms, payloads and analytic tools that can be deployed today for businesses across the agriculture, construction, infrastructure, energy, public safety sectors, and more. UAV-powered solutions enable operators to streamline workflows, empower staff, digitize operations and make daily processes less time consuming and more cost effective, preparing businesses to meet the needs of tomorrow’s workplace.

DJI’s global operations currently span across the Americas, Europe and Asia, and its revolutionary products and solutions have been chosen by customers in over 100 countries for applications in filmmaking, recreation and enterprises across different industries.

Name: Thermodyne Systems
Description:
Thermodyne Systems is located in the major German engineering hub of Stuttgart, home of Mercedes Benz and Porsche. Inspired by innovation, Thermodyne Systems focuses their efforts in handheld thermodynamic systems, with an expertise in portable dry herb vaporizers.

Thermodyne (TDS) has been modeling, prototyping and crafting state-of-the-art devices exclusively for TVAPE, a leading retailer and distributor. Home to the world’s largest library of dry herb vaporizer content, TVAPE is also one of the most visited dry herb vaporizer websites globally. TDS engineers perform independent quality control practices on every exclusive product line that TVAPE carries including Utillian, Zeus, TRONIAN and LITL.

Thermodyne Engineers ensure the quality of their vaporizers by taking the time to disassemble their products and examine them in granular detail. They closely examine the quality of materials they’re made from, their heat resistance as well as how well they’re constructed, in order to ensure they meet the company’s standards of quality.

Customer feedback is continuously framed into quantitative data for TDS engineers. This ensures that products have the procedural framework to become better continuously and incrementally. This is the power of vertical integration.

Thermodyne controls the supply chain and possesses superior business intelligence. Our brands and products rise from a need in the marketplace based on extensive marketing data provided by TVAPE. This ideology, along with the ingenuity of TDS’s creative leadership team makes their products second to none.

Thermodyne is driven by the concept and standard of German Engineering. TDS injects quality, performance and beautiful design features in all that they create.

Name: Nikon GmbH
Description:
Nikon is well known for its reputation as a world leader in imaging products, and its technologies continue to play a significant role in defining the photographic industry.

Nikon’s COOLPIX cameras are helping reshape how people take pictures and share them with others. By integrating sophisticated automatic features, Nikon’s COOPLIX cameras are making digital photography more accessible to consumers and enabling anyone to take stunning pictures.

Nikon’s digital SLR cameras continue to revolutionize photography for professional photographers and photojournalists. With a range of consumer digital SLR cameras, Nikon also offers enthusiasts and virtually anyone looking to take spectacular pictures the speed, quality and durability of its award-winning digital SLR camera technology.

Beyond photography, Nikon is also the leading innovator of precision optical lens and imaging devices. Our array of ophthalmic instruments, Nikon industrial inspection and measuring systems, Nikon microscopes and imaging systems for the biosciences and Nikon surveying instruments are improving the way companies advance their business and professionals care for their clients.

Over the last 90 years, Nikon has consistently moved the photography, imaging and optics industry forward, discovery by discovery and product by product. As we continue our research and development mission to uncover advanced technologies that will enhance the lives of our customers, we also reaffirm our commitment to delivering the highest quality products and support.

Name: HANNspree
Description:
HANNspree is a global consumer electronics manufacturer specialising in visual display and touch technology. We are part of the HannStar Display Corporation one of the largest glass panel manufacturers in the world. 

Headquarter in Taiwan, HannStar is dedicated to the research & development and manufacture of grade-A, high performance glass panels and prides itself on continual development and advancement of new technologies. Company subsidiary HannsTouch boasts being a market leader in touch technology. 

HannStar created the HANNspree brand in 2006 to deliver a new, exciting portfolio of consumer electronic products that stood out from the crowd which successfully managed to shake up an industry associated with mass-production and uniform product design. This strategy put the HANNspree brand on the map and allowed us to successfully transfer our expertise into the design of mass consumer electronics in line with market demand, whilst our sub brand, HannsG, became a leader in the global monitor market with a comprehensive range of carefully crafted monitors.

Both our HANNspree and HannsG brands benefit from a rich heritage and world-class technological prowess in visual technology thanks to the synergy with HannStar.  We now design and supply an array of product to a variety of market sectors enveloping a complete range of display solutions including; computer monitors, Tablet PCs, Wearables, digital signage and entertainment systems. By capitalising on our parent company’s vertical manufacturing capabilities we also have the ability to meet the bespoke demands of the business, corporate, public and commercial markets with our flexible and completely personal product tailoring service (POS, POI, interactive kiosk, retail display, gaming and more). 

Please join us to hear about our latest product developments and to be privy to company announcements.

Name: Lenco
Description:
Lenco has been synonymous for Swiss quality in the area of Hi-Fi and consumer electronics for almost 70 years. Lenco creates inspiring moments of fun, by offering unique video and audio experiences. With a diverse range of consumer friendly technology, Lenco enriches the personal lifestyle of multiple generations worldwide.

The brand is famous for its high-tech turntables. Pure nostalgia but with the newest technology and a fantastic design. Furthermore, with the divers range of Lenco products, such as DAB+ internet radios, bluetooth speakers, portable dvd players and the PlayLink multi-room audio systems, one can enjoy an exceptional sound experience.

Lenco combines its fascination for technology and passion for sound with a strong drive to always be innovative. It designs, produces and supplies high quality products with an attractive price performance ratio. Reliability and durability, that is what the brand stands for. That is why Lenco also develops and manufactures (OEM) products for other consumer electronics brands.

Lenco is the brand for people who live in the now, who want to connect, who want to enjoy their favorite music in the best possible way, or who want to relive the most special moments of their lives through music. That is the spirit of Live Live with Lenco!

The headquarter is located in Nuth, the Netherlands. Furthermore Lenco has offices in Hong Kong, Germany and France. Lenco products are sold throughout the world, in countries where no sales organization is established, this is done by local distributors. 

Each day over 4000 people buy a Lenco product. By emphasizing on quality and workmanship Lenco has become a respected brand in all 50 countries in which it operates. The number of countries in which the brand is represented is still growing. This way, the impressive history of 70 years will be extended even further.

Name: Arditi Spa
Description:

The Arditi products, many of which are innovative and patented, are the result of a constant commitment to Research & Development. They are marketed and sold through an efficient logistics system and a sales and customer network located in five continents. 

The continuous innovation of the design techniques and the completely automatic production plants compliant with the current European standards on environmental impact, allow offering products that satisfy the most demanding international markets.

The competitiveness of the international market is growing every day. 
Arditi responds with automated productions and products certified according to the current international IEC, US, UL and CSA technical standards. 

Compliance to these standards is also verified by systematic controls on the absence of SVHC and RohS, and by the implementation of quality management systems according to ISO 9001:2008 and environmental management systems according to ISO 14001:2004.

Name: Metz Consumer Electronics GmbH
Description:
Seit über 85 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir bei der Metz Consumer Electronics GmbH hochwertige Produkte der Unterhaltungselektronik in Deutschland und zählen damit zu den traditionsreichsten deutschen Unternehmen in der CE-Branche. 
Mit durchdachten Innovationen, aus denen hochwertige, zuverlässige und nachhaltige Produkte hervorgehen, für die beste Qualität ‚Made in Germany‘ unser Maßstab ist, haben wir uns einen Namen gemacht.
Für die außergewöhnliche Langlebigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit, optimale Bild- und auch Tonqualität sowie den hohen Bedienkomfort unserer Fernseher werden wir immer wieder von Fachpresse und Testinstituten ausgezeichnet – wichtige Garanten für den anhaltenden Erfolg unserer Marke Metz Classic.
Technik muss nicht nur funktionieren, sondern auch Spaß machen. Daher gingen wir 2018 gemeinsam mit unserem chinesischen Mutterkonzern SKYWORTH, einem Global Player in der Elektronik-Branche, mit unserer zweiten Marke METZ blue einen ersten Schritt auf internationalem Parkett. Sie bietet starke TV-Geräte mit einem Fokus auf smarte Funktionen für nahezu grenzenloses Entertainment. 
Kurze Wege, interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit und flache Hierarchien gehören bei Metz fest zur Unternehmenskultur. An unserem Hauptsitz befinden sich auch unsere Entwicklungsabteilung für die vollständige Soft- und Hardware sowie die Produktionsstätten für unsere Metz Classic Fernseher sowie unsere leistungsfähige Service- und Reparaturstelle. 
Von unserem Standort im fränkischen Zirndorf bei Nürnberg steuern wir das komplette Europageschäft unseres Unternehmens mit verschiedenen Geschäftsmodellen und befinden uns auf deutlichem Wachstumskurs.

Name: MOUNTAIN
Description:
INNOVATION – PERFORMANCE – AESTHETICS – CUSTOMIZATION

Mountain creates innovative, premium peripherals with a user-centric design that enables gamers to perform at their best. Our vision is for gamers to have what they need to perform, through uncompromising innovation, pioneering design, supreme quality, and customization. 
"Reach Your Summit" is the mantra of Mountain.
 
Our vision is for all Gamers to have the tools they need to perform at the top of their game.
 
Much like climbing a Mountain, gaming takes you on a journey that can be fun, challenging and exciting. Some may seek the thrill of climbing the most challenging slopes, while others are perfectly happy with a hike up an easily approachable mountainside. It doesn’t matter what games we play; the ascension creates the experiences and memories that we love to share, our way to the top of the Mountain.

Name: JINAlert Personal Safety
Description:
Calling 112 with your phone.

Most people panic, freeze, faint, break down, and whatnot in the face of danger. Rapists, burglars, kidnappers, murderers, and other criminals count on this to do their ugly deeds.

Even calm and composed people face the same risk in situations where it is simply not possible to call for help.

In this high tech era, it only makes sense that we have something with us right there and then that makes sure your distress message is sent out.

Quite too often, we are at the mercy of our aggressors.

This needs to stop.

Our mission at JINAlert is to eliminate the "be part of your own rescue" motto that seems to be so widely accepted. Using new technologies, JINAlert monitors the user and analyzes the environment for potential threat. With JINAlert, focus on your own well-being. Run, crunch, fight back, scream, or anything you can think of to get out of harm's way or buy yourself time. JINAlert handles the rest.

Your life is worth saving.

Name: Velolock Germany GmbH
Description:
Velolock designs and engineers LOCK8 - a hardware and software solution, for cost-effective and user-centric bike sharing and fleet management. 

LOCK8 uses GPS, GSM and Bluetooth Low Energy to connect you and your bicycle fleet, so you can manage your fleet with absolute ease, while collating big fleet data.

Our goal is to accelerate the global bike sharing market; optimising existing fleets and providing cheaper, more intuitive solutions to cities and towns, as well as corporate and university campuses. 

Our vision, however, is to enable a vast reduction of CO2 emissions through the reduction of motor-vehicle travel in cities; to contribute to a positive shift in health and wellbeing, by making bicycle travel safer and accessible to more people; to reduce the socio-economic inequality that current public transport costs impose.

Name: ULTRASONE
Description:
Our History

From a true music lover for those, who love music as the greatest way to connect people. The idea for ULTRASONE was born out of a review on the world’s best headphones back in 1985. Great products – but far away from perfection. Improvement in spatial hearing was the clear target for creating better headphones. After four years of intensive research, the first patent was applied and one year later, ULTRASONE was founded. In 1991, the first ULTRASONE-headphones with our famous S-Logic technology were presented to public.
We are worldwide well known for our innovations which have given rise to exclusive technologies, and some of our headphones have gone on to become world-renowned references.

Our Headphones Collection is your opportunity to live an entirely new experience. It will take you beyond sound and allow you to rediscover the sensations provided by sound with unrivalled purity, which reproduces the artist’s original work with absolute fidelity. At the heart of the creation, music opens a world of lost memories, of extraordinary dreams and emotions. This experience embodies our intention to make each moment in life a moment of intense pleasure and exceptionality.

‘Made in Germany’: All ULTRASONE products are designed and developed by our engineers, and a large part of our collections are made in Germany in our own manufactory. All products benefit from innovations which result from the on-going research in the field of acoustics.

Without compromising the music’s quality whatsoever, we apply our entire expertise to serve a wide range of uses, from mobile headphones, professional tools to audiophile reference luxury to fully enjoy all the emotional wealth of the greatest musical masterpieces.

Sustainability

Our goal is to offer excellence in product design, craftsmanship, and ingenuity. Customers recognize craftsmanship in the longevity of our "reference standard headphones." ULTRASONE's carefully built products are made to last forever.

Name: CODINO - Dein Reisepass in die digitale Welt
Description:
Digitalisierung verändert alles und CODINO macht Digitalisierung für jeden begreifbar.

+ FÜR UNTERNEHMEN: Der digitale Wandel verlangt die Fähigkeit, ständig Neues zu lernen. Mit unseren Workshops bringen wir diese Fähigkeit in Ihr Unternehmen. Lernen Sie in Workshops die Grundlage der Digitalisierung: das Programmieren! Aber nicht trocken am PC, sondern bringen Sie LEDs zum Leuchten und vieles mehr - alles mit der Hilfe von Computer-Code!

+ FÜR JEDEN: CODINO möchte allen Jugendlichen in Deutschland die Möglichkeit geben, unsere digitale Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten. Unsere innovativen Programmier-Baukästen sind mehrfach ausgezeichnet und bringen Computer-Code einfach und spielerisch in die reale-Welt. Alle Baukästen umfassen 10 Projekte und enthalten alle notwendigen Bauteile sowie ein ausführliches Handbuch mit Schritt-für-Schritt Anleitungen. Die Projekte sind alle nach dem einzigartigen BUILD-CODE-PLAY Prinzip aufgebaut - Erfolg garantiert! 

CODINO wurde bereits mehrfach ausgezeichnet, u.a. mit dem Innovationspreis Digitale Bildung 2018 unter der Schirmherrschaft des Bundesbildungsministeriums, dem Breakthrough Award der Zeitschrift Connect und dem Gründerpreis des Bundesverbands Digitale Wirtschaft.

Description:
Fast Moving Consumer Electronics Exchange, also known as FMCE the home of business intelligence within the CE industry.

Our B2B aim is to work with individual companies and organisations who are both well established and have a proven track record with an aim to grow and to achieve their potential within this very challenging industry.

After more than 25 years of experience and with a new fresh and strategic approach, our industry is still fast moving and prices are decreasing quickly, however the success of FMCE is increasing and carried forward to all companies that join our unique network. Members using our resources have an edge in today ́s competitive marketplace.

FMCE Exchange unites up to 500 companies within the consumer electronics market such as retailers, distributors, manufacturers, importers, exporters all being experts in this area. As a B2B service provider FMCE is the leader in exchange management information, efficiently being able to sell & supply all major brands including topsellers in large quantities in addition to ideas and information that can be swiftly provided through the normal and the reverse supply chain.

This essential source of information through FMCE covers all market needs. Companies are faced with market research all over Europe with trends about market share and most importantly, up to date information regarding price changes that lowers the risk of unsellable stock. With a unique European outlook, FMCE offers daily updates from the fast moving world of CE along with other value added services leading to a comprehensive source of information that keeps users coming back to the site every day.

For years, partygoers have played Flunkyball – but only in the daylight. Using Funky-Flunky, you can play games at night, in the morning, and any other time that you want.

 We designed Funky-Flunky to take all of the raucous fun of Flunkyball to a new level. The Funky-Flunky ball, meanwhile, features an LED of its own, and lights up your game.

This is going to make the game pop, so the next time you are playing a round, you can see some bright, flashing lights – you know, before the wee hours are approaching.

Using Funky-Flunky, you can make any party into an even better party, and you can make a hangout into a party in the first place. Funky-Flunky is eye-catching in just the right way, and it's bright enough that people will want to join in on your game.
